title: Compute closure to a fixed point
description: Closure adds productions that can begin where an item's dot stands. A fixed point is a set that stays unchanged after another pass.

steps.description: The function copies the starting items into a mutable set. changed controls whether another pass is needed.
The loop reads a snapshot so it can grow result safely. It skips completed items and dots before terminals.
When a dot precedes a nonterminal, the function adds that symbol's productions with their dots at position zero.
Only a new item sets changed to True. After a pass adds nothing, the function returns an immutable frozenset.
